title: Skyrim + official DLC
notes: Stages from Skyrim.esm, Update.esm, Dawnguard.esm, HearthFires.esm, and Dragonborn.esm via xEdit, merged in load order. Questline grouping and order curated by hand against UESP. Verified 2026-09-11.

lines.title: Main Quest
lines.blurb: Alduin, the Greybeards, all of it. Complete it all, or stop partway and start your game as a mid-story Dragonborn.

quests.note: Season Unending is the peace-council quest, and the game skips it on its own if the civil war is far enough along. Selecting it records the truce as brokered.
Completing this quest means Paarthurnax dies. If you'd rather he lived, leave this unchecked; the main quest completes fine without it.

Skuldafn's portal is the only way into Sovngarde, and completing this by console skips the flight there. If you want to play the ending yourself, stop at The Fallen. Otherwise select Sovngarde and Dragonslayer too.

lines.title: Civil War
lines.blurb: Pick ONE side here. For either side, 'Joining' and the 'Jagged Crown' are the only scriptable skips. The campaign battles beyond these reuse radiant quest records for every hold and both sides, so replaying their stages blind would corrupt the war's state. Play the campaign out, or sidestep the war with 'Season Unending' from the main quest.

lines.title: The Companions
lines.blurb: The Jorrvaskr line, 'Take Up Arms' through 'Glory of the Dead'. You end up Harbinger. Oh, and a werewolf.

lines.title: College of Winterhold
lines.blurb: 'First Lessons' through 'The Eye of Magnus'. You end up Arch-Mage.

quests.note: 'Revealing the Unseen' plays before 'Containment' despite the editor IDs.
If the barriers around and inside the College are still up when you arrive, open the console there and run the four prid/disable lines from the batch file again. They only work near Winterhold.

lines.title: College of Winterhold: Side Quests
lines.blurb: Arniel's Endeavor is a four-part series, in order. The apprentices' favors and the master-spell rituals are independent, so they're optional. The rituals normally unlock at skill 90 in their school.

quests.note: Part one of four.

lines.title: Thieves Guild
lines.blurb: 'A Chance Arrangement' through 'Darkness Returns', then the four city-influence jobs on the road to Guild Master. Click 'Darkness Returns' to stop there, or 'Under New Management' for the whole arc.

quests.note: City influence job (Windhelm). Normally unlocked by radiant jobs. All four are needed to become Guild Master.
City influence job (Solitude).
City influence job (Whiterun).
City influence job (Markarth).
No Stone Unturned, Vex's Stones of Barenziah hunt.
Under New Management, the Guild Master capstone.

lines.title: The Dark Brotherhood
lines.blurb: Innocence Lost through Hail Sithis! Or burn the whole thing down instead.

quests.note: Delayed Burial, the Cicero wagon intro. Skippable.
Nazir's twelve fixed side contracts. Sets of these quests normally pace the main questline.
Where You Hang Your Enemy's Head, the post-story sanctuary refurbish.
Kill Astrid and wipe out the Sanctuary instead of joining.

lines.title: Daedric Quests
lines.blurb: Independent artifact quests, unordered, all optional.

quests.note: Azura.
Boethiah.
Clavicus Vile.
Hermaeus Mora. Ties into the main quest's Elder Knowledge.
Hircine.
Malacath.
Mehrunes Dagon.
Mephala.
Meridia.
Molag Bal.
Namira.
Peryite.
Sanguine.
Sheogorath. The batch leaves you in the Pelagius Wing; the door out leads to the Blue Palace.
Vaermina.

lines.title: City Side Quests
lines.blurb: Standalone side quests, unordered, all optional.

quests.note: Leads into No One Escapes Cidhna Mine.
The Man Who Cried Wolf, part one of the Wolf Queen story.
Part two; select The Man Who Cried Wolf as well.
Part two of Blood on the Ice; select part one as well.
Repairing the Phial follows The White Phial; select it as well.
Rising at Dawn, Falion's vampirism cure.

lines.title: Bards College
lines.blurb: Tending the Flames makes you a Bard. The instrument hunts are independent extras.

lines.title: Dungeon Quests
lines.blurb: Self-contained dungeon quests, unordered, all optional.

quests.note: Forbidden Legend spans three dungeons and ends at the Gauldur amulet.

lines.title: Dawnguard
lines.blurb: 'Awakening' through 'Kindred Judgment'. At 'Bloodline' you pick a side: stay mortal with the Dawnguard, or take Harkon's gift and join the Volkihar. Click 'Kindred Judgment' to sweep the shared quests, then click your side's 'Prophet' to fill in the fork.

quests.note: The 'Dawnguard' misc intro: word of the vampire attacks, and directions to Fort Dawnguard.

lines.title: Side Quests
lines.blurb: Optional extras. The Soul Cairn pair assumes the main line has reached 'Beyond Death'.

quests.note: Lost to the Ages, the Aetherium Forge hunt. Independent of the main line.
Durnehviir, in the Soul Cairn.
Impatience of a Saint: Jiub's opus pages, in the Soul Cairn.

lines.title: Dragonborn
lines.blurb: Miraak's story, 'Dragonborn' through 'At the Summit of Apocrypha'.

quests.note: Cleansing the Stones, the remaining All-Maker stones beyond the one 'The Fate of the Skaal' covers.

lines.title: Black Books
lines.blurb: The five side Black Books; the two story books come with the main line. All optional.

lines.title: Solstheim Side Quests
lines.blurb: Raven Rock and the island, all optional except Thirsk Mead Hall at the bottom, where you pick a side.

quests.note: An Axe to Find leads into The Final Descent; select both.
Deathbrand.
Unearthed, the Kolbjorn Barrow excavation.
Paid in Full, Glover Mallory's favor. Expects a Thieves Guild member.
The Ebony Warrior only appears at level 80.

lines.title: House Telvanni
lines.blurb: Neloth's chain in order, then Tel Mithryn's restoration favors.
